summary: First Mining Gold Corp. filed a Form 6-K (foreign private issuer equivalent of a US current report on Form 8-K) furnishing its Q3 2026 financial results and operating highlights via press release dated November 11, 2026. The filing discloses completion of a bought deal public offering of 68,459,500 common shares at $0.84 per share for gross proceeds of $57,506,000, including the full over-allotment, closed September 24, 2026, plus GDXJ index inclusion and project agreements at Springpole. No special-situation transaction terms, board recommendation, or advisor are stated; the item is a routine quarterly results announcement.
